source.title: Open problems risen by Constantin Udriște and his research collaborators.

evidence.quote: Open problems risen by Constantin Udrişte and his research collaborators.
The paper is a survey of problems raised by prof. Constantin Udrişte and his collaborators. They concern extrema theory, vector fields theory, dynamical systems and optimal control.

trace.notes: Resolved the input URL to a zbMATH bibliographic record. The visible source text exposed only title-and-review metadata, not the survey body or any explicit problem statements.

No questions were accepted because no readable exact-work PDF or HTML full-text copy of the same survey was recovered, so extracting from bibliographic metadata alone would violate the source-adequacy gate.
